title: Selling Plans — Plan Change, Cancellation and Early Termination Terms by Tier
content:
The terms below govern, for each **Selling Plans** tier, when a cancellation or a move to another plan or term takes effect, how an upgrade is prorated, and the early termination fee share of an annual term.

| Plan | Cancellation takes effect (monthly term, or no term) | Scheduled cancellation takes effect (annual term) | Early termination fee share of the remaining committed monthly fees | Move to a lower plan or cheaper term takes effect | Lower plan allowed before an annual term ends | Upgrade charge prorated by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Individual Seller Plan | Immediately | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Starter Store | End of the current billing period | End of the term | 50% | Next billing date | No | Remaining calendar days over the days in the billing period |
| Basic Store | End of the current billing period | End of the term | 50% | Next billing date | No | Remaining calendar days over the days in the billing period |
| Premium Store | End of the current billing period | End of the term | 50% | Next billing date | No | Remaining calendar days over the days in the billing period |
| Anchor Store | End of the current billing period | End of the term | 50% | Next billing date | No | Remaining calendar days over the days in the billing period |
| Enterprise Store | Not applicable (no monthly term) | End of the term | 75% | End of the term | No | Remaining calendar days over the days in the billing period |

## Notes by tier

- **Individual Seller Plan.** Held on no term, so a cancellation takes effect immediately and no annual-term item applies.
- **Enterprise Store.** Held on the annual term only; a move to a lower plan or a cheaper term takes effect at the end of the term rather than at the next billing date, and its early termination fee share is 75% rather than 50%.
- **Proration basis, worked on hypothetical figures.** In a 30-day billing period with 12 calendar days remaining, the proration fraction is 12 over 30, which is 0.4.
